description: Admins signed in with a passkey review submissions by status. Opening a row shows the stored gate report, code files and sizes, AI summary and findings with scan coverage, and the diff against the published version. Approve quotes the report digest so you approve exactly what you saw. Reject and an AI-only override ask for a written reason; override covers skills, themes and both plugin runtimes. Missing scans and integrity failures cannot be overridden. The publish worker signs and publishes approved submissions; revoke takes a published item back.
examples: Review a plugin's code inventory and AI findings, then approve publication or reject with a reason.
Revoke a published item and the signed revocation reaches apps at their next index refresh.
how_to: Sign in with your passkey and open a status tab.
Open a row to read code inventory, AI findings and coverage, the gate report and diff; approve, reject or override an AI-only block with a reason.
Open a published row and press revoke with a reason to take it back.
name: Warez admin portal
summary: the admin page at admin.carnivore.ai that shows every submission by status, the gate report, one-click approve and revoke.
